Subject: MAP v3 + proposed monthly TPM smoothing and acceptance playbook

Tom / Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation I attached a refreshed MAP (v3) that stitches together the evaluation plan, acceptance gates, and a smoothing approach for monthly TPM targets so you don’t hit a hard cliff during ramp. High-level summary in-line below and the spreadsheet has the month-by-month token (TPM) grid.

Key pieces (draft):
- Evaluation phase (weeks 1–4): 100k tokens/mo trial, success criteria: latency < 120ms p50, 98% routing availability, and perf parity on sample prompt set (see tab "Evals").
- Transitional ramp (months 1–3 after PO): gradual month-to-month increases (100k -> 300k -> 700k) with a smoothing band of ±10% to account for bursty workloads.
- Committed tiering: 9-month commit (option to accelerate) with commit breakpoints at 500k TPM and 1.2M TPM for progressive discounts.
- Discount trigger: 10% off once commit hits sustained 600k TPM for two consecutive months; 18% at sustained 1.2M.
- Acceptance gates: A/B quality validation and rolling performance sign-off by your infra and ML teams (SLA checklist linked in tab "Acceptance").

Request: please review the MAP spreadsheet and confirm (1) whether the smoothing band is acceptable, and (2) whether PulseData legal/procurement needs a different billing cadence or commit window. If ok, we can convert SOW to a one-page PO path and aim for signature by 6/30 to keep the June pricing.

Attachments: 2026-06-21_MAP_v3.xlsx

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet. Quick notes after an internal sync with Aisha and procurement: 

1) Smoothing band: the ±10% is workable, but we need a little more headroom in month 2 (expecting a marketing spike). Can we make month 2 +20% allowable without changing discount triggers?
2) Discounts: procurement pushed back on the 600k threshold — they prefer guaranteed pricing at 500k TPM with a retroactive true-up if we cross 600k. That gives them comfort on budget forecasting.
3) Timeline: legal wants a 45-day review on the SOW for compliance; that pushes signature to mid-August unless we reduce scope or do a provisional order for the evaluation phase only.

Also — can you break out per-token and per-embedding line items separately in SOW_PulseData_v1.pdf? We want the trial usage to be clearly itemized.

Aisha (cc) will coordinate procurement on our side. I copied Ben and Marissa back so you have Redwood contacts for any commercial flex.

Tom
Head of Cloud Analytics | PulseData

Looping in a couple quick thoughts on the commercial ask from PulseData. My read: their asks are reasonable and we have a few levers: shorten legal review with a provisional EVAL PO, accept a 500k guaranteed commit with retro true-up, and permit a +20% spike allowance in month 2. If we accept the 500k guaranteed commit we should tighten the discount cadence so the 10% hits at sustained 550k for 2 months (middle ground).

Pricing impact (rough): accepting 500k guarantee with retro true-up reduces our near-term ARR certainty by ~6% vs 600k threshold but materially improves closure probability this quarter. Recommend we offer: 
- Evaluation PO (30-day, itemized per-token / embeddings) to start immediately on signature.
- 9-month MAP with a 500k guaranteed TPM line and a retroactive true-up to align to 600k thresholds for discounting; discount step to 10% at 550k sustained x2 months, 18% at 1.2M as-is.
- SOW: include Force Majeure and a 60-day SLA exit clause if perf/regressions fail acceptance gates.

If you want, I’ll draft the SOW changes and the evaluation PO template.

-Marissa
